_comment: Every word on the Google Play graphics (build.mjs), per app and Play language. head: the headline (\n breaks a line, *word* is the accent colour); cap: the line under it (on 08-privacy, the big line under the lock); chips: what the app does, hot = the highlighted one; foot: the footnote; ground: orange | yellow | cream | white | dark. tNN are the tablet screens (7" and 10"). fg: the feature graphic. The survival-kit word and the moniker word are the app's own in each language (js/shared/i18n.js: Survival-Kit in German, kit de survie in French, Moniker everywhere), chips use the app's own tab and wiki names, and every language speaks to the reader as du/tu/tú/você/jij/ty/你.
